plain_text:
Hamden Ice Rink Working Group 
October 8, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
 
The special meeting of the  Ice Rink Working Group was called to order at 7:08  p.m. on 
Thursday, October 8, 2026, at t he 1st Floor Conference Room of  Hamden Government 
Center and also virtually via Zoom.  
 
Present working group members were Dominic Francese, Mike DeFelice, Kristin Dolan, 
Arnold Mann, Arnold Margolis, Ted Stevens, and Grace Teodosio. Greta Johnson was absent. 
Also present were Mayor Adam Send roff, Deputy Chief of Staff Alexa Panayotakis, Public 
Works & Parks Director Joe Colello, and Town Engineer Stephen White.  
 
There was no public comment and no correspondence.  
 
Ted Stevens was nominated for Chair by Ma yor Sendroff. With no further nominations, Ted 
Stevens was elected Chair by unanimous vote and assumed the chair.  
 
Mayor Sendroff nominated himself for Temporary /Acting Secretary. With no further 
nominations, Mayor Sendroff was elected Temporary/Acting Secretary by unanimous vote. 
Grace Teodosio indicated agreement to assume secretarial duties for future meetings. 
 
Presentations regarding the ice arena facility and grounds were made by Director Joe Colello 
and Town Engineer Stephen White.  
 
On motion of Arnold Mann, the meeting was adjourned at 8:57 p.m.  
 
Mayor Adam Sendroff, Acting Secretary
